response.sql: WITH exam_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as exam_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), total_exams AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) as total FROM exam_counts), group_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM exam_counts), with_fractions AS (SELECT ec.ID, ec.exam_count, ec.exam_count * 1.0 / te.total as fraction, 1.0 / gc.num_groups as avg_fraction FROM exam_counts ec CROSS JOIN total_exams te CROSS JOIN group_count gc) SELECT ID, exam_count, fraction, (fraction - avg_fraction) as excess FROM with_fractions WHERE fraction > avg_fraction ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
